question.text: Which of the following statements about promoters of a company is correct?

answer.text: Promoters are institutional investors who invest after the IPO
Promoters have the lowest risk exposure among all investor categories
Promoters cannot exercise voting rights in the company
Promoters provide the initial capital and bear the highest risk

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the NISM Series II-A workbook (page 20), promoters set up the company, bring in the initial capital required to start the business, retain control, and bring in capital at the riskiest stage. The Trap: Option B inverts the source: page 20 explicitly places promoters at the riskiest stage of capital, not the lowest-risk position. Note: Anchor the promoter role to the three workbook attributes - setting up the company, providing initial capital, and retaining control - rather than to broader market commentary.
